name: Zellberg Stüberl
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Zellberg Stüberl in Tirol**

Nestled in the heart of the **Zillertal Alps**, the **Zellberg Stüberl** invites you to experience authentic Tyrolean hospitality in a cozy mountain setting. Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, this charming alpine hut offers breathtaking views of snow-capped peaks and lush green valleys.

Indulge in hearty **Tiroler** specialties like **Kaiserschmarrn** with fresh berries, creamy **Käsekrainer** (cheese-filled sausages), and crispy **Speckknödel**—all prepared with local ingredients. Pair your meal with a frothy glass of **Tiroler Bier** or a warming cup of **Glühwein** (mulled wine) by the crackling fireplace.

Whether you're seeking a peaceful retreat after a day of hiking or a lively gathering with friends, the **Zellberg Stüberl** promises warmth, delicious flavors, and unforgettable moments in the great outdoors. **Prost!**
